rows.prompt: In the clinic supply closet, a person must sort a delayed request queue. The clipboard lists items that have been waiting too long. While reviewing a bin of bandages, they notice a small, hand-knitted item tucked amongst the sterile gauze, something clearly not on any official list and made with unusual care. They pause, picking up the soft fabric with a gentle touch, before deciding whether to log it as an anomaly or set it aside discreetly.

They pick up the carving, turning it over in their hands as they consider its unexpected presence before placing it carefully on a spare chair.

They then quickly gather the scattered pages, deciding how to proceed with the misplaced correspondence.
